cues.text: Thank you for joining me for this brief
video that will walk you through label
and report customization in the
ArtelWare software application. I've
got a lot of information to share with
you. So, let's go ahead and get started.
The ArtelWare application makes it
really easy for users to customize
labels as well as reports that the
application generates. Let's go ahead
and take a look at how this is done. If
you click on the administration icon
located in the far left navigation panel
and from there click on lab policy
settings. From here if you click on the
reporting tab you can see all of the
various options to the different
reporting features to edit any of these
options. Click on the edit lab policy
settings icon located at the top of the
screen. Here you can change your
terminology options as far as reporting
out statistics in
imprecision/inaccuracy,
imprecision sltress or random
error/sistatic
error. You can also change the titles of
your report as well. Let's say that you
want your pipette report title to say my
pipette verification report instead of the
artellar pipette calibration report. In
addition, you can choose to include or
exclude the next due date on your
various reports. Last but not least, if
we scroll down a little bit, you can
also edit and insert your facilities
address as well as upload your
facilities company logo. And if you have
an accreditation logo that you'd also
like included on your reports, you can
click on the ellipsus to upload that
logo as well. Once you've made all of
the changes to the reports as desired,
you can click on the save icon.
But please note that the changes that
you've implemented won't be effective
until the next login. To customize
labels, click on the labeling section of
the lab policy settings area. There are
two labels that our Telware will
generate. The first is an ID label
that's located on the top and it's a
really quick way to begin a pipette
calibration or liquid handler
verification as well. The bottom label
is a device calibration or verification
label. You'll notice that there are some
check boxes for some options that can be
included or excluded on these labels. To
edit your label settings, simply go up
to the icon that says edit lab policy
settings.
And then you can go ahead and check or
uncheck the various items that you'd
like to have included or excluded.
For your calibration or verification
labels, you can also choose to have a
custom date format.
Let's say that I want to have just the
month and the year listed on my label.
Once you've made all of your desired
changes to your labels, select the save
icon in the lower right hand corner. But
know that those changes won't be
affected until your next login.
You might have noticed that both labels
that are generated by the ArtelWare
software application contain an Artell
logo on the far left side of them. There
is a way that you can upload your
facilities logo. Just contact technical
support. Okay, that concludes our brief
tutorial. Do you have additional
questions? Please contact us at 1
option 3 or at support at
aicicompanies.com.
Thank you.
